method: Add loosen_extreme_drought: second loosening tier that pushes entry-gating fields (never position-mechanics fields) one further deterministic step past their normal default once ordinary drought loosening is exhausted AND the drought has persisted past 2x the normal threshold. Fixed a real interaction bug where the ordinary loosener would claw back an extreme-loosened value via exact-equality bound checking.
